top_issues: Lower-left quadrant below the Balances list is dead whitespace while the right rail is full, so the home reads lopsided; the inline legend 'On-chain / Reserve / Secured / Promised' is jargon a first-timer cannot parse and the violet 'Promised $147.99' dwarfs the $0 on-chain without a risk cue.
fixes: Rebalance: pull Recent into the empty left column or add a one-line 'what is safe right now' strip under the balance; rename 'Promised' to 'Hub owes you (not yet collateral)' with a violet dot and a 'move to collateral' affordance.

top_issues: The route card line 'forwards atomically -fee 0.000025 of 0.000050 total' is unreadable arithmetic that contradicts the simpler 'Fee 0.000050 USDC' above it; the two-route chooser exposes hop topology (You→H1→H2 vs You→H1→H3→H2) to a user who only wants to send money.
fixes: Collapse routes to 'cheapest instant route · fee 0.000050 USDC' with the hop map as an expandable detail; delete the '-fee X of Y total' sentence and state fee in plain USD.

top_issues: 'in 8 s' sits awkwardly beside the absolute timestamp with no label, and the Proof hash is truncated with no tap-to-expand or copy affordance, weakening the 'verify the evidence' promise for a security user.
fixes: Label it 'settled in 8 s' on its own row; make Proof and Frame copyable/expandable to full hash.

top_issues: The right column below the two cards is empty and the Entity ID block shows a raw 40-char hex with no copy button (copy exists only on the link); the screen never uses the word 'Invoice', so a freelancer cannot tell this is her invoicing tool.
fixes: Add a copy icon on Entity ID; title the amount+note+link card 'Invoice' and show an open/paid status chip.

top_issues: The primary 'Swap USDC for WETH' button is disabled behind a red 'Prepare incoming capacity before swapping' gate and a collateral/credit slider the user did not ask for — a daily DeFi swapper cannot complete a market swap; the 'Accept it as credit instead' decision is buried mid-card with no consequence shown.
fixes: Default to an executable market swap that auto-opens the needed lane, demote the collateral slider to 'Advanced settlement'; surface the credit-vs-collateral consequence inline before the CTA.

top_issues: Four near-identical numbers ('+95 they owe you', 'send up to 155 / receive up to 48', 'your credit line 143', 'collateral 60') share one card with no arrow tying credit line + collateral to the send/receive limits, so the risk model is derivable but not glanceable; right column is empty under one card.
fixes: Add a one-line derivation 'you can send 155 = 95 owed + 60 collateral + room' and a red 'at risk if hub vanishes' figure pulled from Sovereignty; fill the right rail with lane history.

top_issues: Bottom two-thirds of the page is empty under four rows; Export CSV is the only proof affordance and there is no per-row evidence download, so a treasurer cannot grab one payment's proof for the board.
fixes: Add per-row 'copy proof / export evidence' on selection and a date-range/asset filter; let the list scroll-fill the column.

top_issues: This 'detail' capture is pixel-identical to 07, so the deliverable set contains no distinct detail view and the duplicate signals an unfinished state; the detail panel itself lacks a 'verify on chain / open in explorer' or full-hash expand.
fixes: Ship a real detail variant (expanded proof, signature list, challenge window) instead of duplicating the list; add an expandable proof hash and an 'export this receipt' button.

top_issues: The DESIGN section (Material / Accent / Numbers / Risk color / Sample $1,284,500) is a theming studio that dominates a wallet settings page and pushes the genuinely important Vault actions to the very bottom, where 'Reveal recovery phrase' and 'Forget vault' sit with no visible confirmation step; right rail is empty after the scale card.
fixes: Move theming behind an 'Appearance' sub-page; give Vault a confirm dialog and put it in a bordered danger zone; use the empty right rail for a live preview of the toggled home.

top_issues: The 'WHAT HAPPENS' radio reads 'Fund you through H1' for a self-transfer, which is wrong framing and misleading; there is no network selector, so moving USDT across two chains (the cross-border task) is impossible here; FROM/TO both list the same three lanes with no invalid-combo suppression.
fixes: Rename to 'Post collateral on-chain, then instant'; add a source/destination network picker with the cross-chain fee; grey out no-op FROM=TO pairs.

top_issues: The 2-2-1 tile grid leaves Ownership stranded and the entire right column plus lower half empty, wasting the best copy in the product ('Yours whatever a hub does'); the money-stands summary is excellent but isolated from any action.
fixes: Use a 2x3 tile grid or list; move the 'WHERE YOUR MONEY STANDS' card to the right rail under Accounts and add a 'move promised to collateral' CTA beside the violet figure.

top_issues: The faucet panel reuses the heavy 'Prepare to receive / collateral slider / Accept as credit' block, so grabbing test money requires understanding settlement collateral and the primary 'Receive USDC from H1' is disabled; 'Depository may pull 0.00' repeats under every token as noise.
fixes: Give the faucet a single 'drop 100 USDC' action with the collateral prep hidden until needed; remove the repeated 'may pull 0.00' line or show it only when non-zero.

top_issues: 'Offer to the pool' is disabled with no stated reason (amount 0 / pool empty), and 'Active principal' is undefined jargon; the Borrow tab is referenced by the toggle but never shown, and the right rail is empty below one card.
fixes: Show the disable reason inline ('enter an amount'); define Active principal with a tooltip; render the Borrow form and fill the rail with pool APY history.

top_issues: The page is 60% empty and, critically, offers only explanation — there is no 'add signer', 'change threshold' or 'register entity' action, so a DAO treasurer cannot build the multi-sig board the copy promises; 'Lazy (hash of its board)' and 'EntityProvider' are developer terms leaking into a governance UI.
fixes: Add board-edit actions (add signer, set threshold, register) as buttons; replace 'Lazy/EntityProvider' with 'unregistered board / on-chain registry'.

top_issues: The 'PER COUNTERPARTY' card text overflows its right edge ('...open → Manage → Dispute' is clipped) and the challenge window is static prose rather than a live countdown, so the dispute UX is described but not watched; the green/violet explanation paragraph is dense for the headline number it supports.
fixes: Constrain the counterparty card width and break the route hint onto its own line; turn 'they answer in 1 d' into a ticking countdown with a 'Start dispute' button right there.

top_issues: The 'RECENT' card is rendered with a header and no rows (empty/broken), and the table places 'SEND·RECEIVE 155.00·48.00' next to 'LINES OUT·IN 143.00·0.00' — two colon-paired number columns with no header definition, easy to misread; the desk's instant send/receive ($182.99·$50.80) does not visibly reconcile to the per-lane rows.
fixes: Populate or hide the empty RECENT card; add header tooltips distinguishing 'lane limits' from 'credit lines'; show a totals row that foots the columns.

top_issues: Palette hints use internal voice ('book at the hub', 'dense console') that means nothing to a new user, and the dimmed backdrop still shows the broken empty RECENT card from the desk underneath.
fixes: Rewrite hints to user intent ('trade tokens', 'all accounts table'); ensure the underlying desk renders no empty placeholder cards.

overall.verdict: A coherent, premium obsidian system with a genuinely novel one-scale bar and strong trust scaffolding (before/after panels, sovereignty, evidence bundle), but it is held back by jargon leakage, several dead-end primary actions, broken/empty states and a settings/ownership surface that explains rather than lets you act. The money story is beautiful; the task completion story is not yet.
priority_fixes: Make Swap executable: a default market swap that auto-opens the lane, demoting the collateral/credit slider to advanced (unblocks Anya).
Add a source/destination network picker with cross-chain fee to Pay and Move (unblocks Fatima).
Give Ownership real board actions — add signer, change threshold, register (unblocks Ravi).
Strip jargon from Home/Pay (Promised/Secured/atomically -fee/hop routes) and add a guided first payment (unblocks Maya).
Fix broken deliverables: duplicate 07/08, empty RECENT on Desk, clipped Sovereignty text, disabled buttons without reasons; add per-transaction proof export in Activity.
